items.briefing:
A new study has found that AI security incidents are costing large organisations millions of dollars, a timely warning for Australian businesses increasingly adopting AI tools. Separately, the Clop ransomware group is actively targeting software platforms Windchill and FlexPLM, stealing data from organisations that use these systems — if your organisation uses either, check with your IT team urgently. There is also a newly discovered vulnerability in Microsoft Azure Automation that could allow attackers to access systems across different organisations if default settings are left unchanged.

**Practical tip:** Ask your IT team to review any Microsoft Azure Automation accounts and confirm default identity settings have been securely configured.

featured.title: Australian energy provider Origin says data breach exposes client data - BleepingComputer
featured.quote: Major Australian energy provider's data breach directly impacts thousands of local customers and critical infrastructure.
